conventions.convention: The end is the fixed Cartesian exterior E={r>R₀}, with R₀>0; h is C² and positive definite, K is C¹ and symmetric, hᵢⱼ=δᵢⱼ+aᵢⱼ/r+O₂(r⁻¹⁻ε) for ε>0, and K=O₁(r⁻²). All derivative bounds are uniform in angle.

ADM energy uses outward Euclidean normal nⁱ=xⁱ/R, Euclidean sphere area, and prefactor c⁴/(16πG_N). Coordinates are in metres, energy in joules, and associated mass is E/c². The chart and asymptotic time normalization x⁰=ct remain fixed; no coordinate-invariance or positivity theorem is asserted.

The induced connection is Levi-Civita, with R(X,Y)Z=D_XD_YZ−D_YD_XZ−D_[X,Y]Z, Ricᵢⱼ=Rᵏᵢₖⱼ, and S=hⁱʲRicᵢⱼ. The product Lorentzian construction fixes these conventions without imposing Einstein equations.
All six items are mathematical constructions or deductions; no Einstein constraint, completeness hypothesis, measured input, or empirical conclusion is assumed.

load_bearing.statement: If its limiting integral exists, the fixed-chart ADM energy is c⁴/(16πG_N) times lim(R→∞) ∫_{S_R}(∂ⱼhᵢⱼ−∂ᵢhⱼⱼ)nⁱ dS, for the specified exterior chart, decay, Euclidean normal and area measure.

On the specified fixed-chart end, if u is smooth and positive, u=1+m/(2r)+ρ with real length m and ρ=O₂(r⁻²), h=u⁴δ, and K is any C¹ symmetric tensor with K=O₁(r⁻²), then the ADM limit exists and E_ADM(h;x)=c⁴m/G_N.
For a nonempty open E⊂ℝ³ and smooth positive u, the metric h=u⁴δ has scalar curvature S_h=−8u⁻⁵Δ_δu under the stated induced curvature convention.

Two C² Riemannian metrics on the same end, with the same fixed Cartesian chart and asymptotic time normalization, that agree outside a compact subset and have existing ADM limits have equal ADM energies.

published_dependencies.used_for: The spacelike induced metric and K(X,Y)=g(∇_Xn,Y) convention, and proof step 1.1 establishing the induced Levi-Civita connection with the ambient curvature convention. Both assigned uses concern geometry and do not invoke its conditional Einstein constraint equations.

concerns.concern: The Remarks describe E as an 'exterior manifold with an inner boundary', but the defined E={|x|>R₀} is an open manifold without manifold boundary. The excluded sphere is an ambient boundary of the domain, not part of E. The calculation and incompleteness qualification are unaffected.

alerts.finding: The Statement specifies γ:[0,L₁]→M and permits λ₀∈(0,L₁], then concludes 'γ(λ)∈I⁺(S) (λ₀<λ<λ₀+ε)'. At λ₀=L₁ these evaluations are outside the declared domain. Facts F9 and proof steps 1.1 and 7.1 explicitly establish and use a geodesic extension, so the argument supplies the needed object; the Statement should identify the continued geodesic when expressing this endpoint conclusion.

seams_checked.note: The edge is a declared page prerequisite. Neither assigned page has body prose, and no assigned item invokes a null-screen, Raychaudhuri, index-form, or focal-exclusion conclusion. The actual induced-geometry supplier is the separately opened published normal-frame theorem; no stronger null-geometry claim is attributed across this seam. The ADM definition's radial-section diagram agrees with its excluded domain and outward normal.

The actual ADM citation is in rem-gr-fx-kerr-stability-source-boundary. It explicitly distinguishes the local definition's specialized expansion from the Kerr source's broader asymptotic class, conditions the mass formula on existence of its finite limit, and correctly translates geometric mass into SI energy and mass. It does not infer angular-momentum existence, coordinate invariance, or nonlinear stability from the ADM definition.
